connection_condition: League.country_id references Country.id; each league sits under exactly one country
description: A country's league structure contains its top-division competition; a league record is meaningless without the country it belongs to.

connection_condition: Match.league_id references League.id and is never null
description: A league campaign is composed of its fixtures; a match cannot exist without the competition it belongs to.

connection_condition: Match.season groups matches into one campaign per league
description: A season is the set of matches played within one competition year; the season label has no meaning apart from the fixtures it groups.

connection_condition: Match.stage groups fixtures into matchdays within a league season
description: A matchday is composed of the fixtures played in that round; the stage index exists only as a grouping of matches.

connection_condition: Match.home_team_api_id and Match.away_team_api_id both reference Team.team_api_id, so each match is linked to exactly two of the many teams that persist independently
description: Matches are contested by teams, but a team's identity and record exist independently of any single fixture, so this is relatedness rather than containment.

connection_condition: the eleven lineup slots are columns on the match row itself
description: A line-up is a component of the match it was fielded in; the selection has no meaning detached from that fixture.

connection_condition: the coordinate column index matches the lineup slot index for the same side
description: The position coordinates are a component of the line-up: each slot contributes one coordinate pair describing where that selected player stood.

connection_condition: grouping the eleven slots of one side by their depth coordinate yields the shape
description: Formation is computed from the line-up position coordinates by grouping players into depth lines and counting them; no formation value is stored anywhere.

connection_condition: Match.season labels the campaign
description: Every match belongs to a season, and the season label is the usual scoping device for any time-bounded performance analysis.

connection_condition: a team's league can only be observed indirectly through the league identifiers of the matches it played
description: Teams compete in leagues, but the database stores no team-to-league membership; a club's competition must be inferred from its fixtures.

connection_condition: the home and away scoreline columns are read against the corresponding team role
description: An outcome is only interpretable relative to whose perspective it is read from, and that perspective is the home or away role.

connection_condition: points are awarded per outcome under a convention the analyst supplies
description: League points are derived from match outcomes; because the database stores neither a points column nor the award rule, any points metric depends on an explicitly stated convention.

connection_condition: a team's scoreline column sums the goals attributed to that team
description: Goals scored by a team are the sum of the individual goals credited to it; the scoreline is the stored aggregate of that sum.

connection_condition: a team's conceded column sums the goals attributed to its opponent
description: Goals conceded by a team are the opponent's goals in the same matches, so the same goal events feed both goals-for and goals-against.

connection_condition: goals for contributes positively over an identical match set
description: Goal difference takes a positive contribution from goals scored over the same scope of matches.

connection_condition: goals against contributes negatively over an identical match set
description: Goal difference takes a negative contribution from goals conceded; comparing the two contributions requires the match set to be identical.

connection_condition: comparing a side's scoreline value with its opponent's yields win, draw or loss
description: The match outcome is derived by comparing the goals each side scored in that fixture.

connection_condition: comparing outcome rates between the home and away roles reveals the effect
description: Home advantage is expressed through a systematic difference in outcomes and goals between the two venue roles.

connection_condition: the goalkeeping score columns are five of the same 33 bounded score columns
description: A goalkeeping skill attribute is a kind of player skill attribute: its value domain is drawn from the same bounded rating scale and sits inside the wider set of player ability scores.

connection_condition: both are columns on the same snapshot row, but no stored formula links them
description: The granular skill scores and the single overall rating describe the same player at the same moment, yet the data records no rule deriving one from the other.

connection_condition: both are read from the same snapshot row
description: Potential and overall rating are both judgement scores recorded together for a player, with potential describing the upper bound the player is expected to reach.

connection_condition: height and weight are columns on the player row
description: A player's body measurements are a component of the player record and cannot be interpreted apart from the player they describe.

connection_condition: Player.birthday combined with the observation date yields completed years
description: Age is computed from the recorded birth date and the date at which the player is being observed; the choice of observation date changes the result.

connection_condition: Player_Attributes.player_api_id references Player.player_api_id
description: Each dated attribute measurement belongs to one player and is meaningless without that player.

connection_condition: Team_Attributes.team_api_id references Team.team_api_id
description: Each dated tactical measurement belongs to one club and is meaningless without it.

connection_condition: each class column bands the numeric metric of the same name on the same row
description: The categorical style class is a discretisation of its numeric counterpart: the observed bands partition the metric range into contiguous levels.

connection_condition: the nine numeric columns on one snapshot row jointly constitute that row's profile
description: A team's playing-style profile is composed of its individual tactical facet scores, taken together as one dated description.

connection_condition: the operator is identified only by the column-name prefix of its three price columns
description: Each price belongs to exactly one operator, and comparing prices across operators is only meaningful once the operator is identified.

connection_condition: the decimal price is inverted to obtain the probability it implies
description: Implied probability is computed as the reciprocal of a decimal price; because the three reciprocals of a match exceed one, they are margin-inflated rather than true probabilities.

connection_condition: goal events inside the log carry a team element but the log is present for only part of the matches
description: The event feed describes goals at event level, while the scoreline columns hold the authoritative aggregate; the two representations of the same goals do not always agree.

connection_condition: read from the goal_type element of a goal event
description: The goal type classifies how an individual goal came about.

connection_condition: read from the card_type element of a card event
description: The card type classifies the disciplinary sanction recorded in the event feed.

connection_condition: possession readings are value elements inside the log rather than match columns
description: Ball possession is recorded as repeated readings inside the event feed, so a match-level possession figure has to be chosen from those readings.

connection_condition: Team.team_api_id and Team.team_fifa_api_id are two columns on the same club row, and Team_Attributes carries both
description: The two team identifiers denote the same club under different numbering schemes; either can be used to reach the club, but only the API identifier is complete.

connection_condition: Player.player_api_id and Player.player_fifa_api_id are two columns on the same player row, and Player_Attributes carries both
description: The two player identifiers denote the same footballer under different numbering schemes; both are complete on the player table, but the snapshot table references two more FIFA identifiers than the player table holds.

connection_condition: the work rate columns are read per snapshot row
description: Work rate is an attribute observed about a player at a snapshot date, not a property of the player entity itself.

connection_condition: the preferred foot column is read per snapshot row
description: Preferred foot is an attribute recorded about a player at a snapshot date and is expected to be stable but is stored repeatedly.

connection_condition: Team_Attributes.team_api_id links a profile to its club, available for only six dates
description: A club has a playing style, but the database records it only on a handful of measurement dates, so the style of a club in an arbitrary season is often unobserved.
